_comment: Endpoint audit config. REPORT-ONLY: the audit runs on every PR, writes .audit/endpoint-audit.json, and posts a drift report as a PR comment, but does NOT fail CI (gate.mismatch=false). The client is reconciled against the agent-server only: any client call the agent-server does not expose is reported as off-contract. Additional `classify` specs are fetched live purely to label each off-contract call with the backend that actually serves it (e.g. cloud) vs no known backend at all; if a classify spec is unreachable its labels degrade to 'no known backend'. To make this a blocking gate, set gate.mismatch=true. See scripts/endpoint-audit.mjs.
